concerns.text: The pilot size of N = 1 200 (50 signals per SNR‑bin per bit depth) may be insufficient to reliably detect the 10 % dominance threshold after Bonferroni correction. With only 50 samples per bin, the median Δₖ estimate can be noisy, reducing statistical power below the claimed > 80 % for Cohen’s d≈0.3.

concerns.text: Parameter draws (masses, spins, distances) are only stratified by SNR bin; variation in intrinsic parameters can confound the relationship between SNR and quantization bias. Without fixing or explicitly modeling these covariates, the observed Δₖ may reflect mass‑dependent estimation error rather than pure quantization effects.
